rules: Only one supplied record per current track and itemId is accepted.
Every current review must include all 13 dimensions with item-specific evidence.
Question, file, taxonomy or relevant context/source/scoring/rubric changes invalidate reuse and leave the current item pending.
Missing review is pending, never blocked or approved.
Current review state is not admission, publication, deployment, or human editorial approval.
A contentVersion-only change may reuse an unchanged complete binding only with recorded relevant fact freshness against the target version. No fixed TTL or extra approval is inferred.
Original reviewer, reviewedAt and originContentVersion are retained; reconciliation never fabricates review or coverage evidence.
Current state reads its own currentReviews. Ambiguous review collections and malformed current reviews fail; incomplete legacy rows remain pending with a reason.
nextBatch is the exact cursor: selected product node order, codepoint mentalUnitId then itemId, one unit and at most 20 items or 12 intensive items.
The full input manifest is a concurrent-drift guard; per-review bindings exclude unrelated banks.

Review context projects only current-unit plans/taxonomy, applicable shared node/family policies, declared objective/source/anchor dependencies and review criteria; unrelated unit/source rows and operational cursor/storage settings do not invalidate a review.
An unresolved declared source or objective identifier is exposed in objectiveInputs.sourceResolution and produces no reusable unit review binding; inventory remains unassessed.

A canonical absolute HTTP(S) source URL binds its normalized declared identity and any matching registry metadata. URL resolution is not a remote fetch, fact-check evidence, or factual PASS; review fact-check and version-reuse freshness requirements remain unchanged.

completeRequires: all current unit itemIds individually reviewed and recorded as read
explicit required decisions mapped to current itemIds and source evidence
recorded coverage evidence, reviewer and assessment timestamp
explicit gaps array, empty only if assessed without gaps
